The '''Dwartii system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Allied Region]] known as [[Nouane (Allied Region)|Nouane]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Dwartii system was first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], in a section written by [[Kerrie Dougherty]] focusing on locations from [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> It was later identified in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
